features: previous 3 days bullpen pitch count and innings differences
kbo.feature_schema_status: unresolved; freeze precise definitions and missingness rules before eligibility or fitting; no optimization after evaluation

baseline.historical_control: market90-tipster10-v2 only if frozen contemporaneous evidence exists
baseline.contract_conflict: 2026-10-28 no-vote withhold text versus current code unique market fallback; resolution required before operational promotion

eligibility.sampling_unit: unique match; keep reissues and same-day events in same block
requires: independent official fixture date and kickoff witness
exact complete contemporaneous same-market priced vector and settlement rules
source original hash plus actual completed receipt timestamps no later than as_of and T-30
official results usable only after confirmed availability
pregame player and lineup inputs with separate source timestamp and actual receipt
no cancelled or unverified offer eligibility
no original source counted as new due only to hash/revision/receipt change
eligibility.stop: insufficient verified sample, ambiguous data/identity, clock/receipt failure, unavailable exact feature definitions, leakage or non-reproducible prediction

evaluation.primary_metric: paired per-match log-loss improvement vs market; positive means better
evaluation.chronology: expanding preperiod only; no future fitting or scaler leakage; at least three pre-specified chronological test blocks
evaluation.multiplicity: two league hypotheses, one-sided Holm familywise 0.05; adjusted lower improvement confidence bound above zero
evaluation.uncertainty: paired 7-day blocks bootstrap, 10000 draws, RNG seed 20261101; do not infer with too few independent blocks
evaluation.roi: secondary fixed-unit same event/offer/price/settlement replay, retain abstentions; feasibility unverified is not realized return
evaluation.selection: candidate argmax only; exact ties abstain; no underdog bonus or post-hoc cutoffs
evaluation.promotion: independent new period replication, data rights and clocks verified, T-30 and ledger regression, contract reconciliation, explicit user approval

actions_forbidden: collection of new sports data in this task
